title: Superga Beauty commits EUR 15 million to transform skin and hair care factory
summary: Superga Beauty is launching a EUR 15 million program to transform its BCA – Beauty Champagne-Ardenne – site in Reims, France. An initial EUR 3 million investment was made in 2026 for the renovation of production areas and the acquisition of new equipment. The group intends to make the site a centre of excellence for skincare, hygiene, and haircare, with a gradual ramp-up planned until 2030.
